name: Couatl
description: Large native outsider with 9 RHD. Winged feathered serpent with a venomous bite, constrict, ethereal jaunt, telepathy, psionics, and 9th-level sorcerer spellcasting. LA +7.

ability.name: Darkvision 60 ft.
ability.description: A couatl can see in the dark up to 60 feet.

ability.name: Bite (Ex)
ability.description: Natural weapon: Bite (1d3 plus poison). A couatl's bite is a primary natural attack that delivers its poison.

ability.name: Poison (Ex)
ability.description: Injury poison delivered by the bite, Fortitude DC 16, initial damage 2d4 Str, secondary damage 4d4 Str. The save DC is Constitution-based.

ability.name: Improved Grab (Ex)
ability.description: To use this ability, a couatl must hit a creature of up to two size categories larger with its bite attack. It can then attempt to start a grapple as a free action without provoking an attack of opportunity. If it wins the grapple check, it establishes a hold and can constrict.

ability.name: Constrict (Ex)
ability.description: A couatl deals 2d8+6 points of damage with a successful grapple check.

ability.name: Change Shape (Su)
ability.description: A couatl can assume the form of any Small or Medium humanoid.

ability.name: Ethereal Jaunt (Su)
ability.description: A couatl can shift from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane and back again as a free action, as the ethereal jaunt spell (caster level 9th).

ability.name: Telepathy 90 ft.
ability.description: A couatl can communicate telepathically with any creature within 90 feet that has a language.
